input.first_pass: HRAiN x TRUMP full Meta Registry mechanics ranking

canonical_formula_translation.POLY_FIND: For every reachable nonterminal state S, the frozen algorithm discovers or recognizes a canonically admissible exact action a with charged discovery work <= N^d for one fixed d.
canonical_formula_translation.POLY_HOLD: For every reachable state S_t, total encoded state + representation + certificate + auxiliary + deferred-debt liability remains <= N^c for one fixed c measured against original input length N.
canonical_formula_translation.POLY_ADVANCE: Every committed macrostep preserves exact decision semantics and strictly decreases a well-founded potential mu with mu(S_0) <= N^k and polynomially bounded normalization microsteps.
canonical_formula_translation.EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION: Every committed transition has independently replayable exact semantics/certificate verification with verifier work and bytes charged polynomially in original N.
canonical_formula_translation.DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING: No hidden work is free: failed discovery, representation growth, deferred work, proof bytes, verification, recovery, switching and normalization are charged to the original-N ledger.
canonical_formula_translation.PCNER_GPEI: POLY_FIND AND POLY_HOLD AND POLY_ADVANCE AND EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION AND DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING under one frozen deterministic arbitrary-CNF algorithm.

sat_transfer_rule.conditional_statement: If one fixed deterministic algorithm satisfies the complete PCNER_GPEI obligations for every arbitrary-CNF input and reaches an exact polynomial-time terminal decision, then SAT is in P.
sat_transfer_rule.promotion_rule: A registry artifact may at most be classified as a conditional route candidate. Text similarity, finite controls, or survival of this pass cannot prove the universal premise.
